messages:
DeployBot: PROD deploy started — us-east-1
Environment: prod | initiated by @alex | change window 02:00-04:00 UTC
Commits in this rollout:
- `6a1f2b3` (Alex K) - fix kv cache eviction - https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/6a1f2b3
- `3c9d4e5` (Maria T) - improve batching heuristics - https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/3c9d4e5
PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/428
DeployBot: Rolling canary -> 5 pods (10% traffic) :rocket:

alex: Canary looks stable initially, p50 ~45ms. going to roll to 50% if no regressions.

jen: Heads-up — seeing a spike in 5xx from one canary pod: 2/50 requests 500 on /v1/generate. logs show kv cache OOM errors.
jen: log snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-11-02T02:15:12Z inference/runtime.go:238 - kv cache eviction failed: out of memory
stack: goroutine 512 [running]:
```

DeployBot: Canary healthcheck FAILED — 5xx rate 1.8% > threshold 1.0%. Halting rollout.

maria: Ugh. The batching heuristics PR touched cache sizing. Recommend rollback to last-known-good sha `4f8b2a1` (2026-11-01 22:10).

DeployBot: Initiating rollback to `4f8b2a1` by policy "auto-rollback-on-canary-fail". Rolling back prod -> 3 pods at pinned sha.

sam: Running smoke tests against 4f8b2a1 now (smoke-suite/quick).
sam: /health OK, /v1/generate sample OK, p50 42ms, no 5xx in 1m window.

alex: Thanks. We'll pin 4f8b2a1 for the remainder of the change window and follow up with a small patch to the caching logic. Opening a follow-up ticket and reverting batching changes from PR 428 for immediate safety.

DeployBot: Rollback completed to `4f8b2a1`. Duration: 18m. Incident ticket: PLAT-512. Notifying release manager to update release notes and schedule a patch release in the next change window. :white_check_mark:
